about: NAV-INT-1 H-NI1c authored gold set. pre_registered is DESIGN.md's 60-case set (20 revise / 20 keep / 20 queue) and is the ONLY block the pre-registered criterion (>= 0.90 per class) is read from. The two supplementary blocks are reported separately and never blended into it: supplementary_clarify exercises the classifier's fourth output (an amend/queue cue whose replacement names no resolvable referent, or a place the scene has no name for), and supplementary_context exercises the two context features (conflict with the current goal, distance already travelled) that DESIGN.md's utterance-only class definitions cannot reach.

class_definitions.keep: the utterance is not a navigation command, or is a confirmation
class_definitions.queue: 'after that / when you're done / then' — a directive to run after the current goal
class_definitions.clarify: NOT a pre-registered class; the fourth output, scored as a miss anywhere in pre_registered

place_names: only names the static city itself carries (sidewalk, lamppost, bench, tree, crosswalk, planter, building) plus 'owner' — amendment N4
